title: Cat Video Fest 2026 (Cat & Dog)
synopsis:
Cat lovers are in luck! Cat Video Fest is back and is here to throb your heart! These adorable cats have blessed our cinema in a pur-fect compilation of the world’s best cat videos. Whether they are mischievous, elegant, lazy or aloof, they look equally lovable on the silver screen.

 

Part of the proceeds will be donated to local animal charity LAP to support their animal rescue mission.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
Cat Video Fest 再次來臨！成千上萬的貓貓短片由專人精選直入戲院，讓奴才們好好參拜一下！來自世界各地，戰勝無數貓貓選手殺入大銀幕的王者各有各的武器——無論是敏捷、笨拙、慵懶，還是兇狠的模樣，在大銀幕上一樣不費吹灰征服貓奴！

 

部分收益將捐贈給本地動物慈善機構LAP用予動物救援。
